review.notes:
The goat cdb text matches v2 (DB1-EN177, 2004-10-12) exactly and the lineage has no English version between v2 (2004) and v3 (2015), so the erratum is dated only by that single printing. Versions v0/v1 (PSV, 2002-10-20) precede the baseline text and differ cosmetically ('Magic' -> 'Spell', 'both players take 500 points of Direct Damage' -> 'Inflict 500 points of damage to each player'). Remaining diff lines are inert: 'EVENT_PHASE+PHASE_STANDBY' equals 'EVENT_PHASE|PHASE_STANDBY', and Duel.GetFieldGroup(tp,LOCATION_FZONE,LOCATION_FZONE) covers the same cards as Duel.GetMatchingGroup(aux.TRUE,0,LOCATION_FZONE,LOCATION_FZONE,nil). The packet's second upstream entry, 511002578 'Burning Land (Anime)', is a different card - it destroys only the opponent's Field Spell via EFFECT_SELF_DESTRUCT and applies -700 DEF to the opponent's monsters, with no Standby Phase burn - and is not used. Upstream labels the goat entry's comment 'Burning Land (Pre-Errata)' even though the passcode lives in goat-entries.cdb; that is an upstream naming quirk, not an era claim I could not reconcile.

Round 037 (2026-09-29). Checked against period rulings: the differences the functional transition claims were searched for in the Konami-hosted UDE card FAQ (2008-12), the 2005 UDE card rulings page, Konami's errata lists, rulebooks and per-set ruling documents, and the archived UDE judge-list threads Yugipedia points to (the transition's rulings_check; docs/research/text-only-errata-audit.md, Burning Land). No period ruling in the corpus settles a claimed difference, so the functional call stands unchanged (`unresolved` at both snapshots); the search is recorded in the check. Verdicts: [event] d1 unresolved at Edison, unresolved at Tengu.

effective.basis: TCG release of the first printing carrying the errata'd text (YGLD-ENA31, Yugi's Legendary Decks)

event.historical_text: Destroy all Field Spell Cards on the field. Inflict 500 points of damage to each player's Life Points during his/her Standby Phase.
event.modern_text: When this card is activated: If there are any Field Spell Cards on the field, destroy them. During each player's Standby Phase: The turn player takes 500 damage.
event.summary: Functional erratum: 'Destroy all Field Spell Cards on the field.' becomes 'When this card is activated: If there are any Field Spell Cards on the field, destroy them.', turning a standing effect into a one-shot on-activation effect. The GOAT script implements the era reading with two differences the modern script lacks - an activation requirement (its target function returns false unless Duel.GetFieldGroupCount(tp,LOCATION_FZONE,LOCATION_FZONE)>0) and a continuous EVENT_ADJUST field effect in the S/T Zone that destroys any Field Spell appearing later while Burning Land is face-up (upstream comment: 'Requires a field spell to be faceup to be activated, it'll always destroy any field spell').

rulings_check.difference: Era: 'Destroy all Field Spell Cards on the field' is a standing effect, so a Field Spell that appears while Burning Land is face-up is destroyed as well. Modern: a one-shot 'When this card is activated: If there are any Field Spell Cards on the field, destroy them'.
